findings.text: The new `except HTTPException` branch in `shared_data.py` (closes the file and returns 416 or 412) has no test. Nothing covers an unsatisfiable Range or a failed If-Match through the middleware.

No test checks that a deprecated `fallback_mimetype` is still applied to unknown extensions, or that the default is application/octet-stream. The deprecation test only constructs the middleware. HEAD requests and `cache_timeout=None` with an If-Modified-Since request are also untested.

`generate_etag` is public and may be overridden by subclasses, but it is no longer called. The ETag is now hard-coded as `mtime.timestamp()-size`, so overrides are silently ignored. This is not mentioned in the docs or the changelog.
`self.cache` is stored but no longer used. `self.fallback_mimetype` is also no longer used for serving, and it duplicates `self._fallback_mimetype`. Keeping one of the two would be simpler.
